categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in optical communication products including optical fibre preforms, optical fibres, optical fibre cables, optical transmission components such as optical modules and cables, industrial lasers, submarine cables and marine engineering, specialty optical fibres and cables for niche applications, and high-end quartz materials. It also provides engineering design and customized solutions for telecommunications and other industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced manufacturing technologies including chemical vapor deposition for optical fibre preforms, hollow-core anti-resonant optical fibre technology, large-diameter optical fibre preforms, and synthetic quartz production. It emphasizes R&D in next-generation optical fibres like G.654.E and hollow-core fibres, and integrates AI, 5G, and virtual manufacturing for intelligent manufacturing and digital transformation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are primarily telecommunication network operators in China and overseas, as well as optical fibre and cable manufacturers. The company serves global telecom and datacom markets, utilities, transportation, petrochemical, healthcare sectors, and data centers, with a focus on AI computing power networks and digital economy infrastructure.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with sales in over 100 countries and regions. It has eight production bases across six countries including China, Mexico, Indonesia, South Africa, Poland, and Germany. Overseas revenue accounts for over 30% of total revenue, with active projects in Peru, Indonesia, the Philippines, and other emerging markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the upstream and midstream segments of the optical fibre and cable supply chain, manufacturing optical fibre preforms, fibres, cables, and components. It also extends downstream through integrated system solutions, engineering services, and diversified products like industrial lasers and submarine cables.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include technological innovation in next-generation optical fibres (especially hollow-core fibre), digital transformation, intelligent manufacturing, international expansion, and diversification into industrial lasers, semiconductor materials, and submarine cables. R&D focuses on commercializing advanced fibre technologies, enhancing production efficiency, and developing an industrial ecosystem through investment funds.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of optical fibre preforms, optical fibres, cables, optical components, industrial lasers, and submarine cables. The company also earns from engineering services, customized solutions, and investment income from subsidiaries and joint ventures.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a global leader in optical fibre preforms, fibres, and cables, maintaining a leading delivery share domestically and internationally. It competes with other major global optical fibre and cable manufacturers and has strategic partnerships with major telecom operators. Its technological edge in new fibre types and diversified product portfolio strengthens its market position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB12.2 billion, a decrease of 8.7% from 2023, with a gross profit margin of 27.3%. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB675.9 million, down 47.9%. Overseas revenue accounts for about 33.8% of total revenue. The company has a gearing ratio of 41.4% and maintains stable operating cash flow, with ongoing capital expenditures focused on capacity expansion and diversification.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, innovative optical fibre products tailored for emerging digital economy needs such as AI data centers and 5G networks. Its unique value lies in advanced technologies like hollow-core fibre with ultra-low attenuation, large-diameter preforms, and integrated solutions across diversified segments. It offers customized products, global delivery capabilities, and a strong R&D platform to support next-generation network infrastructure.
